title: Super VRUN music test (Genesis / Mega Drive)
description: A spinoff MUSIC TEST player (modelled on CTW NES's AudioPlayer): the game's real sound driver, every music track of Super VRUN, one extra FL TEST slot (12: a song from an FL Studio project, BrokenDev/tools/music/flp/musictest/build-supervrun-md-mt.ps1; a placeholder song here), looping, per-channel mute/solo from the pad with the channel state on screen, song number and name on screen. A separate build target: the game build is byte-identical.

steps.name: build
steps.note: In a scratch tree (git archive HEAD) under build-mt	ree: musictest\mtpatch_md.py (itconv's song list + fltest, the driver's mute mask, scratch only), gen_assets.py, itconv.py, SGDK with musictest\mt_main.c.

run.note: Up/Down song, A play, B stop, Left/Right channel (F1-F5, DAC, P1-P3, noise), C mute, Start solo, X/Y/Z/Mode every channel on.

scenarios.why: the list draws, THINK plays at power-on, the pad reaches the FL TEST slot

knownIssues: No hardware test on the flash cart yet (Releases\SuperVRUN_MD_MusicTest).
Built from the repository's COMMITTED driver (git archive HEAD), not uncommitted work in the tree.
